**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation running against us. Key checks:

- **Pricing structure** (p0052–p0067): fixed per-unit fee tiers keyed to Monthly Notional Volume bands, with no benchmarking to terms we give third parties.
- **Supplemental Payments** (p0078–p0083): a defined 33% revenue share on clearing fees, give-up fees, half pips, swap rates and spreads — a revenue-share, not an MFN, and not a commitment to extend the Licensor our best terms.
- **Rebate/option consideration** (p0055, p0075–p0076): benefits flowing to us.
- **Targeted searches** for "favorable"/"favourable", "most favored", "best price", "lowest", "discount", "no less favorable" and third-party-terms formulations returned nothing; Articles II, V, VII and the General Provisions have no MFN mechanic.
- **Only third-party comparison** in the document runs in our favour (p0094 — Revisions must be made available to us when generally released to the Licensor's other licensees), which the playbook directs us to leave untouched.

This sits at the preferred position (no MFN burden on the Customer), so nothing to redline.
